verdicts.title: Constructions of Rank-Metric Codes of Small Tensor Rank
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Rank-metric codes are subspaces of matrices over finite fields endowed with the rank metric and admit a natural tensorial representation. The tensor rank provides a measure of the minimal size of a decomposition of a code into rank-one tensors. verdicts.title: A Normal Form Algorithm for Tensor Rank Decomposition
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We propose a new numerical algorithm for computing the tensor rank decomposition or canonical polyadic decomposition of higher-order tensors subject to a rank and genericity constraint. Reformulating this computational problem as a system of polynomial equations allows us to leverage recent numerical linear algebra tools from computational algebraic geometry. We characterize the complexity of our algorithm in terms of an algebraic property of this polynomial system -- the multigraded regularity.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract describes a numerical algorithm for tensor rank decomposition using multigraded regularity, with no mention of algebraic curves over function fields or Frege proof complexity. It shares only the 'tensor rank' vocabulary with the conjecture.
